    • isValidParent

      protected boolean isValidParent(Expression parent)
      Description copied from class: Expression
      Whether this node can be an operand of the given node. Called by the parent when the operand is set, to check what the grammar can't: e.g. a condition can only be an operand of a condition aggregate. By default any parent is valid.
      Overrides:
      isValidParent in class ConditionExp

    • parenthesizeAsOperand

      protected boolean parenthesizeAsOperand()
      Description copied from class: Expression
      Whether this node is wrapped in parentheses when printed as an operand of another node. Compound nodes are, leaves and nodes with their own delimiters (function calls, lists) are not.
